weaknesses.title: BEFOREF/AFTERF only first delimiter occurrence
weaknesses.detail: Path a/b/c peels first / only. Nested metrics host:ns:name need repeated AFTERF. No LAST-delimiter peel.

weaknesses.title: BEFORE miss keeps whole; AFTER miss empties — asymmetric
weaknesses.detail: Agents must check BEFOREF_N/AFTERF_N; silent whole-keep on BEFORE miss can look like success host=full_label.
weaknesses.repro: BEFOREF nocolon → LAST_N=0 still whole string

weaknesses.title: NUMF partial parse 42x→42 NUMF_OK=1
weaknesses.detail: Looks successful while trailing junk discarded. No strict full-string numeric mode.

weaknesses.title: No multi-field peel macro — copy label to host/name/tag first
weaknesses.detail: BEFOREF mutates in place; must GETF label + SETF scratch field before each peel or destroy source.
weaknesses.repro: host action copies label to host then peels

weaknesses.title: Empty needle BEFORE→empty AFTER→whole
weaknesses.detail: Dangerous with blank SEP env; can wipe field.

weaknesses.title: STRF normalizes leading zeros 07→7
weaknesses.detail: May break zero-padded metric ids if treated as numbers.
